source.name: Ford Racing: Ford Racing and Proton Competition kick off WEC campaign at Imola
source.quote: continuing its partnership with Proton Competition. From 17-19 April, the team will field two upgraded Ford Mustang GT3s
source.note: Both 2026 Mustangs run a full Ford Racing livery (hood, windshield banner, wing endplates) on the official WEC car renders (fiawec.com car pages #77/#88).

source.name: FIA WEC: Goodyear extends LMGT3 tyre partnership with long-term commitment
source.quote: Goodyear has been the production-based category's exclusive tyre-supplier since its inception two years ago
source.note: Goodyear logos (front wings, rear quarters, tyre sidewalls) on both cars in the official WEC render; Goodyear is shown as 'Tyre partner' on the fiawec.com #77/#88 car pages. Series-wide deal also recorded as data/deals/wec-goodyear.json.

source.name: FIA WEC: Proton Competition #77 - 2026 car page with official Mustang LMGT3 render
source.note: A 'FARO' logo appears in the front-fender sticker stack of the official car render on this page (identical on the #88 page). Image-only, so there is no text to quote; date is the access date.

summary: 2026 Ford Mustang LMGT3 (Proton runs #77 and #88), full Ford Racing factory livery. Ford is the front-level brand, Goodyear the LMGT3 tyre partner; Staloc, FARO, Fried Sped, Sparco and Milwaukee appear as small sticker-stack logos. Two or three further small fender logos could not be read/identified on the official renders.
